SELECT
    bottypeval AS robot_type,
    AVG((safety_metrics->>'safety_incident_score')::numeric) AS avg_sis,
    MAX((safety_metrics->>'safety_incident_score')::numeric) AS max_sis
FROM
    robot_details AS rd
JOIN
    performance_and_safety AS ps
        ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
WHERE
    (safety_metrics->>'safety_incident_score')::numeric IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    bottypeval
ORDER BY
    avg_sis DESC;

SELECT
    o.apptypeval AS application_type,
    AVG(ps.energyusekwhval) AS average_eer,
    MIN(ps.energyusekwhval) AS least_efficient_rank
FROM 
    performance_and_safety ps
JOIN 
    operation o ON ps.effectivenessoperation = o.operreg
WHERE 
    ps.energyusekwhval > 0.01 
    AND o.totopshrval > 1000
GROUP BY 
    o.apptypeval
ORDER BY 
    least_efficient_rank DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    mf.upkeeprobot AS robot_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN mf.issuecategoryval ILIKE '%safety%' THEN mf.issuelevelval END) AS safety_incident_score,
    MAX(mf.faultpredscore) AS recent_fault_prediction_score
FROM 
    maintenance_and_fault AS mf
JOIN 
    robot_record AS rr ON mf.upkeeprobot = rr.botcode
GROUP BY 
    mf.upkeeprobot, rr.botcode
HAVING 
    MAX(CASE WHEN mf.issuecategoryval ILIKE '%safety%' THEN mf.issuelevelval END) = 'High'
ORDER BY 
    safety_incident_score DESC, recent_fault_prediction_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT

    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mf.faultpredscore DESC, mf.rulhours ASC) AS maintenance_priority,
    mf.faultpredscore AS fault_score,
    mf.rulhours AS remaining_life,
    rr.rects AS timestamp
FROM 
    maintenance_and_fault AS mf
JOIN 
    robot_details AS rd ON mf.upkeeprobot = rd.botdetreg
JOIN 
    robot_record AS rr ON rd.botdetreg = rr.botcode

SELECT 
    mf.upkeeprobot AS robot_id,
    mf.faultpredscore AS predicted_failure_risk,
    mf.rulhours AS min_remaining_useful_life,
    op.totopshrval AS toh,
    op.progcyclecount AS num_operations,
    CASE 
        WHEN mf.faultpredscore > 0.6 AND mf.rulhours < 500 THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN mf.faultpredscore > 0.4 OR mf.rulhours < 500 THEN 'WARNING'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS maintenance_priority_level
FROM 
    maintenance_and_fault AS mf
JOIN 
    operation AS op ON mf.upkeepoperation = op.operreg
ORDER BY 
    predicted_failure_risk DESC, min_remaining_useful_life ASC;

SELECT 
    rd.botdetreg AS robot_id,
    AVG(ps.toolwearpct) AS avg_tool_usage_severity,
    SUM(ps.toolwearpct) / COUNT(ps.toolchangecount) AS twr_value,
    COUNT(ps.toolchangecount) AS tpc_value,
    AVG(op.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time_sec,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(ps.toolwearpct) / COUNT(ps.toolchangecount) > 0.001 AND COUNT(ps.toolchangecount) > 10000 THEN 'URGENT'
        WHEN SUM(ps.toolwearpct) / COUNT(ps.toolchangecount) > 0.0005 OR AVG(ps.toolwearpct) > 75 THEN 'WARNING'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS tool_status
FROM 
    performance_and_safety ps
JOIN 
    operation op ON ps.effectivenessoperation = op.operreg
JOIN 
    robot_details rd ON ps.effectivenessrobot = rd.botdetreg
GROUP BY 
    rd.botdetreg
ORDER BY 
    tool_status ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH EER_Ranks AS (
    SELECT
        t2.apptypeval,
        (t1.energyusekwhval / NULLIF(t1.pwrfactorval, 0)) AS eer,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY t2.apptypeval
            ORDER BY (t1.energyusekwhval / NULLIF(t1.pwrfactorval, 0)) DESC
        ) AS eer_rank
    FROM
        performance_and_safety AS t1
    JOIN
        operation AS t2 ON t1.effectivenessoperation = t2.operreg
)
SELECT
    apptypeval AS application_type,
    AVG(eer) AS average_eer,
    MIN(eer_rank) AS least_efficient_rank
FROM
    EER_Ranks
GROUP BY
    apptypeval
ORDER BY
    average_eer ASC;

WITH ModelSeriesStats AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS number_of_robots,
        AVG(op.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time,
        AVG(op.progcyclecount) AS avg_programs_per_robot,
        op.currprogval AS most_efficient_program,
        AVG(ps.effectivenessindexval) AS avg_oce,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN ps.effectivenessindexval = 0 THEN 1 END) AS underperforming_robots
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    JOIN 
        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    GROUP BY 
        rd.modelseriesval, op.currprogval
),
RankedModelSeries AS (
    SELECT 
        model_series,
        number_of_robots,
        avg_cycle_time,
        avg_programs_per_robot,
        most_efficient_program,
        avg_oce,
        underperforming_robots,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_cycle_time ASC) AS cycle_activity_rank
    FROM 
        ModelSeriesStats
)
SELECT 
    model_series,
    number_of_robots,
    avg_cycle_time,
    avg_programs_per_robot,
    JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'most_efficient_program', most_efficient_program,
        'avg_oce', avg_oce
    ) AS efficiency_stats,
    underperforming_robots
FROM 
    RankedModelSeries
WHERE 
    cycle_activity_rank = 1
LIMIT 1;

f610dd3da572891da655f6741d6e863647f6b671.sql:
WITH RobotMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.botdetreg AS robot_id,
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,
        ps.effectivenessindexval AS oce_value,
        op.progcyclecount AS tpc_value,
        AVG(op.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time,
        COUNT(DISTINCT op.currprogval) AS unique_programs,
        SUM(op.totopshrval) AS operation_time,
        CASE 
            WHEN ps.effectivenessindexval < 100 AND op.progcyclecount > 500000 THEN 'Low Efficiency'
            WHEN ps.effectivenessindexval < 150 OR op.progcyclecount > 300000 THEN 'Medium Efficiency'
            ELSE 'High Efficiency'
        END AS efficiency_category,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rd.modelseriesval ORDER BY ps.effectivenessindexval DESC, op.progcyclecount DESC) AS efficiency_rank
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    JOIN 
        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    WHERE 
        op.progcyclecount > 100000
    GROUP BY 
        rd.botdetreg, rd.modelseriesval, ps.effectivenessindexval, op.progcyclecount
),
RankedRobots AS (
    SELECT 
        robot_id,
        model_series,
        oce_value,
        tpc_value,
        avg_cycle_time,
        unique_programs,
        operation_time,
        efficiency_category,
        efficiency_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY oce_value DESC, tpc_value DESC) AS overall_rank
    FROM 
        RobotMetrics
)
SELECT 
    robot_id,
    model_series,
    oce_value,
    tpc_value,
    avg_cycle_time,
    unique_programs,
    operation_time,
    efficiency_category,
    efficiency_rank
FROM 
    RankedRobots
WHERE 
    overall_rank <= 100
ORDER BY 
    oce_value DESC, tpc_value DESC;

921e48f4b56dcc6a5a6063a847e103a3cb254b86.sql:
WITH ape_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.botdetreg, 
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ctrltypeval ORDER BY AVG(t2.poserrmmval) DESC) AS ape_rank
    FROM robot_details AS t1
    JOIN actuation_data AS t2 ON t1.botdetreg = t2.actdetref
    GROUP BY t1.botdetreg
)
SELECT 
    t1.ctrltypeval AS controller_type, 
    AVG(t2.poserrmmval) AS average_position_error, 
    MAX(t4.ape_rank) AS max_ape_rank, 
    AVG(t3.faultpredscore) AS average_recent_fault_prediction_score, 
    COUNT(t1.botdetreg) AS robot_count
FROM 
    robot_details AS t1
JOIN 
    maintenance_and_fault AS t3 ON t1.botdetreg = t3.upkeeprobot
JOIN 
    actuation_data AS t2 ON t1.botdetreg = t2.actdetref
JOIN 
    ape_rank AS t4 ON t1.botdetreg = t4.botdetreg
WHERE 
    t3.issuelevelval IN ('Low', 'Medium') AND 
    DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, t1.instdateval)) > 5
GROUP BY 
    t1.ctrltypeval
ORDER BY 
    t1.ctrltypeval;

    t1.ctrltypeval;

WITH deleted_records AS (
    DELETE FROM maintenance_and_fault mf
    WHERE mf.faultpredscore < 0.05
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM robot_details rd
        WHERE rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot

)
SELECT * FROM deleted_records;

WITH latest_maintenance AS (
    SELECT 
        upkeeprobot AS bot_id,
        issuecategoryval AS safety_issue,
        faultpredscore AS fault_prediction_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY upkeeprobot ORDER BY rects DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        maintenance_and_fault AS m
    JOIN robot_record AS r ON m.upkeepactuation = r.recreg
),
safety_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        effectivenessrobot AS bot_id,
        (safety_metrics->>'safety_incident_score')::FLOAT AS safety_incident_score
    FROM 
        performance_and_safety
)
SELECT 
    l.bot_id,
    s.safety_incident_score,
    l.fault_prediction_score
FROM 
    latest_maintenance AS l
JOIN safety_scores AS s ON l.bot_id = s.bot_id
WHERE 
    l.rn = 1
    AND l.safety_issue = 'Safety'
    AND s.safety_incident_score > 0
ORDER BY 
    s.safety_incident_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

4da7568ea1cdde0f5c57736b7881b298ba71e6b1.sql:
WITH latest_maintenance AS (
    SELECT 
        upkeeprobot AS robot_id,
        faultpredscore,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY upkeeprobot ORDER BY rects DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        maintenance_and_fault AS m
    INNER JOIN 
        robot_record AS r ON m.upkeepactuation = r.recreg
),
safety_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
        COALESCE(
            (
                CASE WHEN safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops' ~ '^\d+$'
                     THEN (safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::float
                     ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE WHEN safety_metrics->>'collisions' ~ '^\d+$'
                     THEN (safety_metrics->>'collisions')::float
                     ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE WHEN safety_metrics->>'overloads' ~ '^\d+$'
                     THEN (safety_metrics->>'overloads')::float
                     ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE WHEN safety_metrics->>'speed_violations' ~ '^\d+$'
                     THEN (safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::float
                     ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE WHEN safety_metrics->>'zone_violations' ~ '^\d+$'
                     THEN (safety_metrics->>'zone_violations')::float
                     ELSE 0
                END
            )
        , 0) AS safety_incident_score
    FROM 
        performance_and_safety
)
SELECT 
    l.robot_id,
    s.safety_incident_score,
    l.faultpredscore
FROM 
    latest_maintenance AS l
JOIN 
    safety_scores AS s ON l.robot_id = s.robot_id
WHERE 
    l.rn = 1 
    AND s.safety_incident_score > (
        SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.8) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY safety_incident_score) 
        FROM safety_scores
    )
    AND l.faultpredscore > (
        SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.8) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY faultpredscore) 
        FROM latest_maintenance
    )
ORDER BY 
    s.safety_incident_score DESC, l.faultpredscore DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH maintenance_priority AS (
    SELECT 
        upkeeprobot AS robot_id, 
        CASE 
            WHEN faultpredscore > 0.6 AND rulhours < 500 THEN 'CRITICAL'
            WHEN faultpredscore > 0.4 OR rulhours < 500 THEN 'WARNING'
            ELSE 'NORMAL'
        END AS maintenance_priority
    FROM maintenance_and_fault
)
SELECT 
    rd.botdetreg AS "Robot ID", 
    mf.faultpredscore AS "Predicted Failure Risk", 
    mf.rulhours AS "Minimum Remaining Useful Life", 
    mp.maintenance_priority AS "Maintenance Priority Level",
    rd.modelseriesval AS "Model Series",
    rd.bottypeval AS "Robot Type",
    o.totopshrval AS "Total Operating Hours"
FROM 
    robot_details rd
JOIN 
    maintenance_priority mp ON rd.botdetreg = mp.robot_id
LEFT JOIN 
    maintenance_and_fault mf ON rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot
LEFT JOIN 
    operation o ON rd.botdetreg = o.operbotdetref
ORDER BY 
    mf.faultpredscore DESC, 
    mf.rulhours ASC;

WITH most_efficient_program AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.modelseriesval, 
        t3.currprogval AS most_efficient_program, 
        AVG(t2.effectivenessindexval) AS avg_oce
    FROM 
        robot_details t1
    JOIN 
        operation t3 ON t1.botdetreg = t3.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety t2 ON t2.effectivenessoperation = t3.operreg
    GROUP BY 
        t1.modelseriesval, t3.currprogval
    ORDER BY 
        avg_oce DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    t1.modelseriesval AS model_series_name, 
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_robots, 
    AVG(t3.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_activity_stats_metrics, 
    JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'most_efficient_program', mep.most_efficient_program,
        'avg_oce', mep.avg_oce
    ) AS program_info, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.effectivenessindexval < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS underperforming_robots
FROM 
    robot_details t1
JOIN 
    operation t3 ON t1.botdetreg = t3.operbotdetref
JOIN 
    performance_and_safety t2 ON t2.effectivenessrobot = t1.botdetreg
LEFT JOIN 
    most_efficient_program mep ON t1.modelseriesval = mep.modelseriesval
GROUP BY 
    t1.modelseriesval, mep.most_efficient_program, mep.avg_oce
ORDER BY 
    avg_cycle_activity_stats_metrics ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH prog_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,
        op.currprogval AS program,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS robot_count,
        AVG(op.progcyclecount) AS avg_cycle_activity,
        AVG(ps.effectivenessindexval) AS avg_OCE,
        SUM(op.progcyclecount * ps.effectivenessindexval) AS total_weighted_cycles
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    JOIN 
        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    GROUP BY 
        rd.modelseriesval, op.currprogval
),
model_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        model_series,
        SUM(robot_count) AS total_robots,
        AVG(avg_cycle_activity) AS avg_cycle_activity,
        MAX(total_weighted_cycles / NULLIF(robot_count, 0)) AS max_efficiency_score,
        MAX(program) AS most_efficient_program,
        AVG(avg_OCE) AS avg_OCE
    FROM 
        prog_stats
    GROUP BY 
        model_series, program
),
underperforming_robots AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS underperforming_count
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    JOIN 
        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    WHERE 
        ps.effectivenessindexval < (SELECT AVG(effectivenessindexval) FROM performance_and_safety)
    GROUP BY 
        rd.modelseriesval
)
SELECT 
    ms.model_series,
    ms.total_robots,
    ms.avg_cycle_activity,
    JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'most_efficient_program', ms.most_efficient_program,
        'avg_OCE', ms.avg_OCE
    ) AS efficiency_stats,
    COALESCE(ur.underperforming_count, 0) AS underperforming_robots
FROM 
    model_stats ms
LEFT JOIN 
    underperforming_robots ur ON ms.model_series = ur.model_series
ORDER BY 
    ms.max_efficiency_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH qualifying_robots AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.effectivenessrobot AS robot_id, 
        ps.conditionindexval AS jdi, 
        op.totopshrval AS toh
    FROM 
        performance_and_safety ps
    JOIN 
        operation op ON ps.effectivenessoperation = op.operreg
    WHERE 
        ps.conditionindexval > 1.5 
        AND op.totopshrval > 5000
),
regression_slopes AS (
    SELECT 
        qr.robot_id, 
        SUM(qr.jdi * qr.toh) AS sum_xy, 
        SUM(qr.jdi) AS sum_y, 
        SUM(qr.toh) AS sum_x, 
        SUM(qr.toh * qr.toh) AS sum_x_squared, 
        COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM 
        qualifying_robots qr
    GROUP BY 
        qr.robot_id
),
robot_details AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, 
        rd.mfgnameval AS manufacturer, 
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series, 
        rd.bottypeval AS robot_type, 
        rd.payloadcapkg AS payload_capacity, 
        rd.reachmmval AS reach_mm, 
        rd.instdateval AS installation_date, 
        rd.fwversionval AS firmware_version, 
        rd.ctrltypeval AS controller_type
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
)
SELECT 
    rd.robot_id, 
    rd.manufacturer, 
    rd.model_series, 
    rd.robot_type, 
    rd.payload_capacity, 
    rd.reach_mm, 
    rd.installation_date, 
    rd.firmware_version, 
    rd.controller_type, 
    (rs.n * rs.sum_xy - rs.sum_x * rs.sum_y) / (rs.n * rs.sum_x_squared - rs.sum_x * rs.sum_x) AS jdi_toh_slope
FROM 
    regression_slopes rs
JOIN 
    robot_details rd ON rs.robot_id = rd.robot_id
ORDER BY 
    rd.robot_id
LIMIT 10;

WITH qualifying_robots AS (
    SELECT 
        botdetreg AS robot_id,
        mfgnameval AS manufacturer,
        modelseriesval AS model_series,
        bottypeval AS robot_type,
        payloadcapkg AS payload_capacity_kg,
        reachmmval AS reach_mm,
        instdateval AS installation_date,
        fwversionval AS firmware_version,
        ctrltypeval AS controller_type,
        totopshrval AS total_operating_hours,
        conditionindexval AS joint_degradation_index
    FROM 
        robot_details
    JOIN 
        operation ON robot_details.botdetreg = operation.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety ON robot_details.botdetreg = performance_and_safety.effectivenessrobot
    WHERE 
        conditionindexval > 1.5 
    AND 
        totopshrval > 5000
)

SELECT 
    robot_id,
    manufacturer,
    model_series,
    robot_type,
    payload_capacity_kg,
    reach_mm,
    installation_date,
    firmware_version,
    controller_type,
    (
        COUNT(*) * SUM(total_operating_hours * joint_degradation_index) - 
        SUM(total_operating_hours) * SUM(joint_degradation_index)
    ) / (
        COUNT(*) * SUM(total_operating_hours * total_operating_hours) - 
        POWER(SUM(total_operating_hours), 2)
    ) AS jdi_toh_regression_slope
FROM 
    qualifying_robots
GROUP BY 
    robot_id, manufacturer, model_series, robot_type, payload_capacity_kg, reach_mm, installation_date, firmware_version, controller_type
ORDER BY 
    robot_id
LIMIT 10;

WITH qualifying_robots AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.botdetreg AS robot_id,
        rd.mfgnameval AS manufacturer,
        rd.modelseriesval AS model,
        rd.bottypeval AS type,
        rd.payloadcapkg AS payload_capacity,
        rd.reachmmval AS reach,
        rd.instdateval AS installation_date,
        rd.fwversionval AS firmware_version,
        rd.ctrltypeval AS controller_type,
        op.totopshrval AS total_operating_hours,
        ps.conditionindexval AS joint_degradation_index,
        ps.effectivenessindexval AS effectiveness_index,
        ps.qualitymeasureval AS quality_measure,
        ps.energyusekwhval AS energy_use_kwh,
        ps.pwrfactorval AS power_factor,
        ps.airpressval AS air_pressure,
        ps.toolchangecount AS tool_change_count,
        ps.toolwearpct AS tool_wear_percentage,

        mf.faultpredscore AS fault_prediction_score,
        mf.faulttypeestimation AS fault_type_estimation,
        mf.rulhours AS remaining_useful_life_hours,
        mf.upkeepduedays AS maintenance_due_days,
        mf.upkeepcostest AS maintenance_cost_estimate,
        jp.joint_metrics AS joint_performance_metrics,
        jc.j1tempval AS joint_1_temperature,
        jc.j2tempval AS joint_2_temperature,
        jc.j3tempval AS joint_3_temperature,
        jc.j4tempval AS joint_4_temperature,
        jc.j5tempval AS joint_5_temperature,
        jc.j6tempval AS joint_6_temperature,
        jc.j1vibval AS joint_1_vibration,
        jc.j2vibval AS joint_2_vibration,
        jc.j3vibval AS joint_3_vibration,
        jc.j4vibval AS joint_4_vibration,
        jc.j5vibval AS joint_5_vibration,
        jc.j6vibval AS joint_6_vibration,
        jc.j1backval AS joint_1_backlash,
        jc.j2backval AS joint_2_backlash,
        jc.j3backval AS joint_3_backlash,
        jc.j4backval AS joint_4_backlash,
        jc.j5backval AS joint_5_backlash,
        jc.j6backval AS joint_6_backlash
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    LEFT JOIN 
        maintenance_and_fault mf ON rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot
    LEFT JOIN 
        performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    LEFT JOIN 
        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    LEFT JOIN 
        joint_performance jp ON rd.botdetreg = jp.jperfdetref
    LEFT JOIN 
        joint_condition jc ON rd.botdetreg = jc.jcdetref

        AND (

        )
        AND op.totopshrval > 5000
),
regression_calculation AS (
    SELECT 
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(total_operating_hours * joint_degradation_index) - SUM(total_operating_hours) * SUM(joint_degradation_index)) /
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(total_operating_hours * total_operating_hours) - POWER(SUM(total_operating_hours), 2)) AS regression_slope
    FROM 
        qualifying_robots
)

    qr.manufacturer,
    qr.model,

    qr.payload_capacity,
    qr.reach,

    qr.firmware_version,
    qr.controller_type,
    qr.total_operating_hours,
    qr.joint_degradation_index,

    qr.quality_measure,
    qr.energy_use_kwh,
    qr.power_factor,

    qr.tool_change_count,
    qr.tool_wear_percentage,
    qr.safety_metrics,
    qr.fault_code,
    qr.issue_category,

    qr.fault_prediction_score,
    qr.fault_type_estimation,
    qr.remaining_useful_life_hours,

    qr.joint_1_backlash,
    qr.joint_2_backlash,
    qr.joint_3_backlash,
    qr.joint_4_backlash,
    qr.joint_5_backlash,
    qr.joint_6_backlash,
    rc.regression_slope
FROM 
    qualifying_robots qr
CROSS JOIN 
    regression_calculation rc

WITH qualifying_robots AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.botdetreg AS robot_id,
        rd.mfgnameval AS manufacturer,
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,
        rd.bottypeval AS robot_type,
        rd.payloadcapkg AS payload_capacity_kg,
        rd.reachmmval AS reach_mm,
        rd.instdateval AS installation_date,
        rd.fwversionval AS firmware_version,
        rd.ctrltypeval AS controller_type,
        op.totopshrval AS total_operating_hours,
        ps.conditionindexval AS joint_degradation_index,
        jc.j1tempval AS joint_1_temp,
        jc.j2tempval AS joint_2_temp,
        jc.j3tempval AS joint_3_temp,
        jc.j4tempval AS joint_4_temp,
        jc.j5tempval AS joint_5_temp,
        jc.j6tempval AS joint_6_temp
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    JOIN 
        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    JOIN 
        joint_condition jc ON rd.botdetreg = jc.jcdetref
    WHERE 
        ps.conditionindexval > 1.5 
        AND (
            jc.j1tempval > 65 OR jc.j2tempval > 65 OR jc.j3tempval > 65 
            OR jc.j4tempval > 65 OR jc.j5tempval > 65 OR jc.j6tempval > 65
        )
        AND op.totopshrval > 5000
)
SELECT 
    qr.robot_id,
    qr.manufacturer,
    qr.model_series,
    qr.robot_type,
    qr.payload_capacity_kg,
    qr.reach_mm,
    qr.installation_date,
    qr.firmware_version,
    qr.controller_type,
    (
        COUNT(*) * SUM(qr.total_operating_hours * qr.joint_degradation_index) 
        - SUM(qr.total_operating_hours) * SUM(qr.joint_degradation_index)
    ) / (
        COUNT(*) * SUM(qr.total_operating_hours * qr.total_operating_hours) 
        - POWER(SUM(qr.total_operating_hours), 2)
    ) AS regression_slope
FROM 
    qualifying_robots qr
GROUP BY 
    qr.robot_id, qr.manufacturer, qr.model_series, qr.robot_type, 
    qr.payload_capacity_kg, qr.reach_mm, qr.installation_date,

ORDER BY 
    qr.robot_id

WITH robot_eer AS (
    SELECT
        o.apptypeval AS application_type,
        p.energyusekwhval AS energy_usage,
        o.totopshrval AS total_operating_hours,
        (p.energyusekwhval / o.totopshrval) AS eer
    FROM
        performance_and_safety AS p
    JOIN
        operation AS o
    ON
        p.effectivenessoperation = o.operreg
),
robot_avg_eer AS (
    SELECT
        application_type,
        AVG(eer) AS average_eer
    FROM
        robot_eer
    GROUP BY
        application_type
),
robot_rank_eer AS (
    SELECT
        application_type,
        eer,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY eer) AS eer_rank
    FROM
        robot_eer
    GROUP BY
        application_type, eer
)
SELECT
    a.application_type,
    a.average_eer,
    r.eer_rank
FROM
    robot_avg_eer AS a
JOIN
    robot_rank_eer AS r
ON
    a.application_type = r.application_type
ORDER BY
    eer_rank;

95bedfccc27464928c7078257c63143a9fd55957.sql:
WITH robot_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.botdetreg AS robot_id,
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,
        SUM(op.progcyclecount) AS total_program_cycles,
        SUM(op.cycletimesecval) / COUNT(op.operreg) AS avg_cycle_time,
        COUNT(DISTINCT op.currprogval) AS unique_programs,
        op.totopshrval AS operation_time
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    JOIN 
        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    GROUP BY 
        rd.botdetreg, rd.modelseriesval, op.totopshrval
),
robot_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.*,
        (total_program_cycles / SUM(total_program_cycles) OVER (PARTITION BY model_series)) AS efficiency_score
    FROM 
        robot_metrics rm
),
robot_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        re.*, 
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY model_series ORDER BY efficiency_score DESC) AS efficiency_rank
    FROM 
        robot_efficiency re
)
SELECT 
    rr.robot_id,
    rr.model_series,
    rr.total_program_cycles AS tpc,
    rr.avg_cycle_time,
    rr.unique_programs,
    rr.operation_time,
    rr.efficiency_score AS oce,
    rr.efficiency_rank
FROM 
    robot_ranking rr
WHERE 
    rr.total_program_cycles > (SELECT AVG(total_program_cycles) FROM robot_metrics)
ORDER BY 
    rr.efficiency_rank ASC;

08b75e55270b8ba2a3b0f3ad104fdf9e35e9fa88.sql:
WITH robot_operation_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, 
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series, 
        -- Assuming OCE value is the average effectiveness index value
        ps.effectivenessindexval AS oce_value, 
        o.progcyclecount AS tpc_value, 
        AVG(o.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.currprogval) AS num_unique_programs, 
        SUM(o.totopshrval) AS operation_time, 
        -- Assuming efficiency category is the average effectiveness index value
        AVG(ps.effectivenessindexval) AS efficiency_category, 
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rd.modelseriesval ORDER BY AVG(ps.effectivenessindexval) DESC) AS efficiency_rank
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    JOIN 
        operation o ON rd.botdetreg = o.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    GROUP BY 
        rd.botdetreg, rd.modelseriesval, ps.effectivenessindexval, o.progcyclecount
),
large_program_cycles AS (
    SELECT 
        robot_id, 
        model_series, 
        oce_value, 
        tpc_value, 
        avg_cycle_time, 
        num_unique_programs, 
        operation_time, 
        efficiency_category, 
        efficiency_rank
    FROM 
        robot_operation_efficiency
    WHERE 
        tpc_value > (SELECT AVG(tpc_value) FROM robot_operation_efficiency)
)
SELECT 
    robot_id, 
    model_series, 
    oce_value, 
    tpc_value, 
    avg_cycle_time, 
    num_unique_programs, 
    operation_time, 
    efficiency_category, 
    efficiency_rank
FROM 
    large_program_cycles
ORDER BY 
    efficiency_rank
LIMIT 10;

f1deccafde1a0f74e4c7723f77fd98fe4822adec.sql:
WITH safety_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
        (
            (safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::int + 
            (safety_metrics->>'collisions')::int + 
            (safety_metrics->>'overloads')::int + 
            (safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::int + 
            (safety_metrics->>'zone_violations')::int
        ) AS sis
    FROM performance_and_safety
)
SELECT 
    rd.bottypeval AS robot_type,
    AVG(sm.sis) AS average_sis,
    MAX(sm.sis) AS max_sis
FROM 
    robot_details rd
JOIN 
    safety_metrics sm ON rd.botdetreg = sm.robot_id
WHERE 
    sm.sis > 20
GROUP BY 
    rd.bottypeval
ORDER BY 
    average_sis DESC;

228592491e9516823fc3cdf2d47aac37c468416b.sql:
WITH sis_scores AS (
    SELECT
        rd.bottypeval AS robot_type,
        (safety_metrics->>'overloads')::INT +
        (safety_metrics->>'collisions')::INT +
        (safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::INT +
        (safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::INT AS sis
    FROM 
        performance_and_safety ps
    JOIN 
        robot_details rd ON ps.effectivenessrobot = rd.botdetreg
    WHERE 
        safety_metrics->>'safety_state' != 'Normal'
)
SELECT
    robot_type,
    AVG(sis) AS avg_sis,
    MAX(sis) AS max_sis
FROM 
    sis_scores
GROUP BY 
    robot_type
ORDER BY 
    max_sis DESC;

WITH tool_usage AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
        AVG(ps.toolwearpct) AS avg_tool_usage_severity,
        SUM(ps.toolwearpct) / NULLIF(COUNT(ps.toolwearpct), 0) AS twr_value,
        COUNT(ps.toolwearpct) AS tpc_value,
        AVG(op.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time_sec
    FROM 
        performance_and_safety ps
    JOIN 
        operation op ON ps.effectivenessoperation = op.operreg
    GROUP BY 
        ps.effectivenessrobot
)
SELECT 
    tu.robot_id,
    tu.avg_tool_usage_severity,
    tu.twr_value,
    tu.tpc_value,
    tu.avg_cycle_time_sec
FROM 
    tool_usage tu
ORDER BY 
    tu.avg_tool_usage_severity DESC
LIMIT 10;

091be8f7c97b064ee6a036394bf2782e9899205f.sql:
WITH tool_wear_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
        SUM(t1.toolwearpct) / t2.progcyclecount AS twr
    FROM 
        "performance_and_safety" AS t1
    JOIN operation AS t2 ON t1.effectivenessrobot = t2.operbotdetref
    GROUP BY 
        t1.effectivenessrobot, t2.progcyclecount
),
tool_replacement_status AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.robot_id,
        SUM(t2.toolchangecount) AS tpc,
        CASE 
            WHEN twr > 0.001 AND SUM(t2.toolchangecount) > 10000 THEN 'URGENT'
            WHEN twr > 0.0005 OR AVG(t2.toolwearpct) > 75 THEN 'WARNING'
            ELSE 'NORMAL'
        END AS tool_status
    FROM 
        tool_wear_rate AS t1
    JOIN "performance_and_safety" AS t2 ON t1.robot_id = t2.effectivenessrobot
    GROUP BY 
        t1.robot_id, twr
)
SELECT 
    t1.effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
    AVG(t1.toolwearpct) AS avg_tool_usage_severity,
    twr.twr AS twr_value,
    trs.tpc AS tpc_value,
    AVG(t2.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time_sec,
    trs.tool_status
FROM 
    "performance_and_safety" AS t1
JOIN operation AS t2 ON t1.effectivenessrobot = t2.operbotdetref
JOIN tool_wear_rate AS twr ON t1.effectivenessrobot = twr.robot_id
JOIN tool_replacement_status AS trs ON t1.effectivenessrobot = trs.robot_id
GROUP BY 
    t1.effectivenessrobot, twr.twr, trs.tpc, trs.tool_status
ORDER BY 
    twr.twr DESC;
